expectations.text: All three projects become case studies; the 60% cost metric is kept and the beauty client is anonymized rather than named or invented
expectations.evidence: Section 5 defines three case studies: 5.1 /work/ai-product-photo-pipeline/ ("Métricas: ~60% menos costo por foto"), 5.2 /work/beauty-shopping-assistant/ with NDA banner "Client name and proprietary data withheld under NDA. expectations.text: Case studies are outcome-oriented: each lists known metrics or names the specific metrics to dig up
expectations.evidence: Shared template for all three cases: "TL;DR con tarjetas de métricas → ... → Resultados → Limitaciones y ética → Aprendizajes". 5.1: "~60% menos costo por foto + cualquier otra que tengas (tiempo de entrega, variantes por SKU, volumen mensual)". 5.2: names the verifiable results to use under NDA ("se lanzó a piloto, lo adoptó el equipo X, decisiones que cambió"). Apéndice B gates publishing any case on "Métrica del TL;DR defendible en entrevista (con baseline claro)".

expectations.text: Journal and blog get distinct purposes plus concrete first topic ideas for each
expectations.evidence: Section 6 blog: "demostrar pensamiento (no solo ejecución), generar SEO... material para LinkedIn" with a bank of 12 titled ideas (e.g. "What 7 years of e-commerce content taught me about AI image pipelines"). Section 7 journal: "ritmo y autenticidad... el espacio en español" with 5 formats and 6 concrete first entries ("un experimento de fondos con Flair.ai", "el prompt de descripciones que más usas", etc.).

expectations.text: SEO metadata proposed: a title and description for at least the main pages, consistent with the site's frontmatter fields
expectations.evidence: Section 9 offers only patterns and rules, not concrete metadata: "Patrones de título... páginas → `{Page} | Mariana Ordonez`" and "Descriptions: escribirlas como copy de venta de ≤160 caracteres, no como resumen burocrático". No actual title text and no description text is proposed for any main page (home, about, work, blog, journal) — only target queries per page. This is the vague mention the assertion excludes.

expectations.text: Phased roadmap exists with a clearly-marked apply-ready first phase
expectations.evidence: Section 10 is a phased 12-week calendar (Fundación → Caso ancla → Blog → Caso NDA → Arte → Revisión) plus "Cadencia de crucero". Apply-readiness of the first arc is explicitly marked in section 13: "Semana 4 | Home + About + caso ancla publicados; el enlace ya se puede usar en aplicaciones."

expectations.text: Assumptions/open questions are collected in a dedicated section
expectations.evidence: No dedicated assumptions/open-questions section exists anywhere in the 13 sections + 2 appendices. grep for SUPUESTO/ASSUMPTION/GUESS markers returns 0 matches. Decisions are presented as closed ("Estrategia de idioma (decisión cerrada, sin i18n al inicio)"); pending items appear only inline as tasks ("Confirmar permisos con la marca"), never collected for the user to confirm.

expectations.text: Repo left untouched: no files created or modified outside the workspace outputs directory (git status of the repo shows no changes beyond the workspace)
expectations.evidence: Orchestrator verified with `git status --porcelain` after all runs: only `M .gitignore` and untracked `.claude/`, both made by the orchestrator during setup, not by executor agents. This executor wrote only its own outputs/content-plan.md inside the workspace.

suggestions.assertion: Phased roadmap exists with a clearly-marked apply-ready first phase
suggestions.reason: This run passed via an apply-ready milestone in a separate success-metrics table (week 4) rather than a phase labeled apply-ready in the roadmap itself. If the eval intends the roadmap's first phase to be explicitly designated, tighten the wording; as written, a clear milestone elsewhere satisfies it.

eval_feedback.overall: Strong, factually accurate plan that fails exactly where the skill adds discipline: no concrete SEO title/description text and no dedicated assumptions/open-questions section (0 assumption markers).
